title: Grace M. Heiderscheidt (product leader) after a decade in Bay Area startups — 'This book has made me want to build again'
summary: Heiderscheidt is a product leader with more than a decade of Bay Area startups behind her, and had settled into low expectations of the work. She picked the book up from one of the little libraries at Lenny Rachitsky's gathering and posted that it restored her appetite for building. She hopes it proves half as influential on tech as Lean.
blockquote:
Can we talk about this book? After over a decade in Bay Area startups, I accepted that a good company and a good product were fleeting moments of joy in a long career drudge.  This book has made me want to build again.  

If you want to do work that STAYS mission and valued aligned. Go read this.
